`frontend-golden.json`: from https://huggingface.co/redbaty/ytm-lyrics-aligner (MIT licence): a 2 s synthetic signal and the features that transformers' `SeamlessM4TFeatureExtractor` makes of it, used by `tests/seamless_golden.rs` to check `src/seamless.rs`.
The other files are the Demucs transform fixtures made by `tools/lyric-sync/make_golden_dsp.py`.
